headline: Binance Sees $4.7 Billion in Client Withdrawals Following Platform Hack
summary: Binance clients pulled $4.7 billion following a platform hack, with net outflows representing 3% of total assets and suggesting customer confidence largely held up.
why: Massive cryptocurrency exchange outflows test platform liquidity and systemic stability across digital asset markets following security breaches.
why_moved: Significant withdrawals from a major exchange highlight counterparty risk and liquidity concerns across the broader cryptocurrency sector.
